_meta.description: Statutory payroll deductions for Pakistani university payroll: EOBI, GP Fund subscription, and FBR income tax slabs for salaried individuals.
_meta.source: EOBI: http://www.eobi.gov.pk/introduction/Contribution.html and https://mercans.com/resources/statutory-alerts/change-in-minimum-wage-for-eobi-calculations/ (FY 2025-26 minimum wage Rs 40,000); GP Fund: Finance Division O.M. No.F.1(5)-Reg.7/87-317 dated 31-08-2022 (https://www.finance.gov.pk/circulars/circular_31082022.pdf); Income tax: Finance Act 2025 salaried slabs TY 2025-26 (https://taxwizard.pk/tax-slabs, cross-checked https://www.ict.edu.pk/blogs/income-tax-slabs-pakistan-2025-26)

eobi.wage_base_note: Contributions are calculated on the statutory minimum wage, not actual salary. Minimum monthly wage Rs 40,000 for FY 2025-26 (Punjab, Sindh, KP, ICT; Balochistan remained at Rs 37,000) => employer Rs 2,000/month, employee Rs 400/month.

gp_fund.note: General Provident Fund monthly subscription per Finance Division uniform rates (O.M. 31-08-2022, deductions from Sept 2022 pay onward). Amounts are fixed per BPS, derived from minimum percentage of the mean of the relevant BPS-2022 pay scale: BPS-1 3%, BPS-2 to 11 5%, BPS-12 to 22 8%. Applies to pensionable government employees; not applicable to TTS faculty.

income_tax_notes.basis: Annual taxable salary income, TY 2025-26 (Finance Act 2025). Each slab: tax = fixed + rate_percent% of the amount exceeding the previous slab's up_to.
income_tax_notes.salaried_definition: Salaried rates apply where salary exceeds 75% of taxable income
income_tax_notes.surcharge: 9% surcharge on computed tax where annual taxable income exceeds Rs 10,000,000
